pc-network-picker.public-current: You're on the public papchat network.
pc-network-picker.separated: Someone else has a network called "{name}" with a different password. Your group stays separate until you enter that password below, then everyone here moves across.
pc-network-picker.name: Network name
pc-network-picker.hint: Joins the network with this name, or creates it if there is none. Leave the password empty for an open network.
pc-network-picker.link-hint: Anyone with this link can join. It contains the network's password.
pc-network-picker.link-hint-public: Anyone with this link can join.
pc-network-picker.nosave: Ask everyone not to save chats
pc-network-picker.nosave-hint: Only when this makes a new network. It's a request, not a rule: any device can keep what it receives.
pc-network-picker.ring-hint: Only when this makes a new network. Everyone links to two people instead of several, so it's lighter on each device, but messages take longer in a big group.
pc-network-picker.anchor-yes: Yes, this device keeps the network findable
pc-network-picker.listed-no: No, new people can't find it
pc-network-picker.alone: Only you. Anyone else is in another network.
